{{Top|leg}}
'''Rigglen''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Rigglen commented on the entry for the [[TreeFelling vibrosaw]], noting that it could cut through bulkheads and armored doors as easily as it did [[Tree/Legends|trees]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
